name: Grand Recovery
body:
Ganeshans are masters at expanding upon the use of ki, deriving from multiple resources.

Prerequisite(s): Ganeshan, Intelligence 15, Wisdom 15, ki pool class feature, extra ki, character level 11

Benefit(s): Once per day you may choose to add a number of ki points to your ki pool equal to your intelligence or wisdom modifier, up to your maximum amount of ki. You retain this ki for a number of rounds equal to your character level, after which any unused ki goes away.

Special: A monk may ignore the racial prerequisite as long as he meets all other prequisites in order to select this feat as a monk bonus feat.
